identical_pairs.population: selected paired uppercase native symbols with literal equality

substituted_pairs.population: selected paired uppercase native symbols with literal inequality

query_gap_columns.population: selected columns with a query gap

reference_gap_columns.population: selected columns with a reference gap

alignment_identity.population: selected realized alignment columns including gaps

query_paired_coverage.population: complete original query operand in native coordinate units

reference_paired_coverage.population: complete original reference operand in native coordinate units

taxonomy.counts_meaning: taxon memberships; one sequence may occur in more than one taxon

source_quality.meaning: reported measurements, separated by method; not category-derived reliability grades

dependence.meaning: groups collapse demonstrated sequence identity; distinct groups are not claimed independent experiments

search_limits.meaning: all supplied hit rows retained; hitting a limit can censor evidence, fewer hits do not establish database completeness
